status: pending: owner calipers (spec 2026-10-16 nvblox object-aware §8, Q5)
reference_frame: Fingertip plane (gripper_end origin) and the finger axis, jaws closed. x is back along the jaws, y across the jaws (camera side up), z up. front_behind_tip / rear_behind_tip: distance of the camera + padding + bracket envelope's front / rear face behind the fingertip plane (rear includes the padding); minus_y / plus_y: its extents across the jaws, measured separately; bottom_above_axis / top_above_axis: its bottom / top above the finger axis.
rule: Every face moves outward to the next 5 mm (rear, top and the wider side up; front and bottom down). A null keeps today's slab for that face (safety.tool_volume.camera_faces_from_calipers). The first measured face ships together with safety.tool_volume.housing and .fingers in configs/arms/rebot_rs.yaml (tests/test_tool_volume_parts.py).
